guidance: Slack is reached through the Web API with a bot token from a Slack app installed in the workspace. The bot can only read or post in channels it has been invited to, so invite it to every channel the plan names; private channels and DMs need extra scopes an admin must approve. Prefer channels over DMs, post one message per item so people can thread on each, and expect rate limits of about one message per second per channel.

setup.notes: Ask the Slack workspace admin to create or install a Slack app for this automation and to approve the scopes it needs, such as reading channel history and posting messages.
